Follow instructions in ~/.agents/commands/to-execute-next-open-tactic.md to pick a tactic and complete its tasks exclusively within the Maintenance project (7052D534-0D70-45D1-BFB5-4A6C5B77E08D). Do not select tactics from any other project.

Sort the tactics by version and always start with the lowest version (tactics use semver). Then from lowest version tactic pick the free task with the top priority.

Do not complete more than 2 tasks. Create one thread for each task if they are not related (do not reuse the same thread for unrelated tasks).
